question: Which videos prepare Caesar dressing from scratch without using mayonnaise?

observed_information.statement: v1 shows a creamy dressing poured onto a salad with lettuce, bacon, and croutons and later shows a finished Caesar salad.
v1 shows egg yolks, minced garlic, a yellowish paste, and oil being whisked into a pale yellow emulsion.
v2 shows lemon juice and olive oil added to raw chicken, seasoning and mixing, then salad assembly and tossing without showing the dressing mixing interval.

v3 shows a kitchen graphic with a fried egg and shopping list, toasted bread cubes, and a glass cup containing a white liquid plus a thick creamy substance that is stirred into a pale creamy dressing.
v3 shows croutons and pink meat chunks added to romaine lettuce.
v4 displays a Classic Caesar Salad title and shows lemon juice, minced garlic, crushed anchovy, and a yellow creamy dressing whisked with egg visible on the counter.
v4 shows romaine lettuce and shredded cheese added to the large bowl.

working_relations.statement: v1 and v4 both show a yellow creamy dressing being whisked in a Caesar-salad context, but neither report confirms the identity of the yellow base.
v1 shows an oil-emulsion dressing sequence with unlabeled ingredients, while v3 shows a thick creamy substance added to a white base whose identity is unresolved.
v2's salad dressing preparation is not shown, whereas v3's dressing preparation is shown but includes an unresolved creamy ingredient.
v4 explicitly titles a Classic Caesar Salad and shows anchovy/garlic/egg ingredients, while v2 shows lemon and oil with chicken but no explicit Caesar dressing preparation.
